wind-energy-turbine.alt: A wind turbine on a tall tower with three blades and a nacelle. Wind arrows push on the blades. A callout of the inside of the nacelle shows a shaft, a gearbox and a generator in a row: faster rotation, generator, electricity. An arrow at the base carries electricity to power lines. A list reads: no fuel and no emissions while running; land below can still be farmed or grazed; output varies with the wind (intermittent); blades can kill birds and bats.
